newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank appoints Haferkamp to board.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank appoints Haferkamp to board.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Friday that Dieter Haferkamp had been appointed to the board of the German central bank.
Haferkamp's term is to extend from December 1, 1996 until December 31, 2004, the Bundesbank said in a statement.

The appointment had been widely expected after a German newsletter said three weeks ago the government had appointed the 59-year-old, who was head of the Bundesbank personnel department and has worked at the central bank since 1968.
Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer gave Haferkamp a certificate of appointment, the statement said.
Haferkampf replaces Gerd Haeusler, who left the Bundesbank to join Dresdner Bank AG earlier this year.
A newspaper reported in August that Tietmeyer had persuaded Chancellor Helmut Kohl to give the job to a Bundesbank insider rather than make a political appointment.
The Bundesbank board, or directorate, is made up of eight members, including Tietmeyer.
